Class LocalAnomaly

java.lang.Object
imageproof.LocalAnomaly
public class LocalAnomaly extends Object
Local anomaly rule for ONE image. It only re-uses numbers that already exist: tile TVD from Regions, residual variance from Noise and Sobel means from Edges.

A tile is "flagged" when ALL of these hold:

  1. Histogram: its neighbour TVD is a high outlier compared with the other tiles of THIS image (modified z-score at least Z_LIMIT, from Iglewicz and Hoaglin) and the TVD is at least MIN_TVD.
  2. Noise: its residual variance differs by a factor of NOISE_RATIO or more (larger or smaller) from the median of its neighbouring tiles (up to 8). At least MIN_NEIGHBOURS neighbours are needed, and the comparison is skipped when both variances are below NOISE_FLOOR.
  3. Not explained by a boundary: its own edge strength is not itself a high outlier (modified z-score at least Z_LIMIT).
  4. Agreement: at least one of its 8 neighbours also meets rules 1 to 3. Isolated tiles are ignored.

Edge strength is NOT a vote. It only explains boundaries (rule 3).

The result is a MEASURED AREA of unusual tiles. It is not a probability of editing or forgery. Tiles can be unusual for normal reasons, and an image with no flagged tiles is not proven to be authentic. TamperingAssessment turns this area into a cautious summary.
